What the service does

Report Ready provides document formatting, optional PDF conversion, formatting summaries, templates and Free team workspaces. Each account has five formatting/PDF jobs per UTC calendar month. A team workspace supports up to five members and shares its owner's Free job allowance. Failed jobs do not use a monthly job. There are no paid plans, checkout, or subscriptions in the service.

Your account and documents

Provide an email address you control and keep your sign-in credentials secure. You remain the owner of documents you submit. You are responsible for having the necessary rights and permissions to upload and process them. You grant the operator only the limited permission needed to store, process and return files as part of the service.

Documents are processed on the service's server and stored temporarily. Their expiry follows the retention setting shown in the app, normally 24 hours on the hosted Free service; cleanup may occur after the exact expiry time. The service is not an archive or backup system. Keep your original files and download copies you need.

You can delete your account and associated live service data using Account and privacy → Delete account and data. Deletion also removes a team workspace you own and its shared templates. Provider backups or logs may remain for their applicable retention periods. See the Privacy Notice.
